name: Asbury University
academic_ranking: Private Christian liberal arts university. U.S. News 2025: No. 31 Regional Universities South, No. 14 Best Value Schools. 12:1 student-to-faculty ratio, 82% of faculty hold terminal degrees, 82% retention rate. Test-blind admissions; 2024 acceptance rate approx. 64%, admitted students averaged 3.65 HS GPA. Offers 59 undergraduate majors.
financial_aid: Per NCES (2023-24), 100% of full-time beginning undergraduates received financial aid; 100% received grant or scholarship aid averaging approx. $39,001. Institutional grants/scholarships awarded to 99%, state/local grants to 71%, federal Pell grants to 48%, and 50% took student loans. Endowment approx. $78.15M (2024).
facilities_notes: Softball plays at the Cecil Zweifel Baseball & Softball Fields within the Kirkland Complex on the Asbury campus in Wilmore, KY. No additional facility feature details are published on the athletics facilities page.
program_reputation: NCAA Division III program in the Collegiate Conference of the South (also affiliated with NCCAA). Program maintains a published softball record book. No notable national ranking data found publicly as of research date.
notes: Data compiled from asburyeagles.com softball coaches/roster/facilities pages, asbury.edu, NCES College Navigator, and Wikipedia, researched 2026-07. Tuition value ($48,770) is the NCES 2024-25 published tuition-and-fees figure; tuition-only figure not separately published on the school site. NCAA D3 schools do not offer athletic scholarships, so scholarship_count is null.
